title: Singler 2015 Language and Ethnicity in Liberia
text: The name Glaro-Twabo is based on the two dialects that form the language; it is spoken in southeastern Grand Gedeh County. Linguists are not in agreement as to how many Grebo languages there are. The Ethnologue map of languages in Liberia shows six Grebo languages, and the TILL survey (Ingemann & Duitsman, 1976) concludes that there are seven.
